title: Catalogue and readiness review
job: Review catalogue evidence and operational readiness without changing company records.

steps.title: Read catalogue evidence
steps.instructions: Read every product, price basis, MOQ, quantity step, selling rule and worked example. A source-specific parser is company state; every row has an outcome and evidence. Resolve conflicts by dated canonical source.
steps.done_when: The catalogue gate has been evaluated against recorded source evidence; conflicts and missing evidence remain explicit.

steps.title: Judge operational readiness
steps.instructions: Evaluate existing evidence for the store stage without ingesting facts, reserving stock, booking capacity or changing company records. Read the source goal as the subject of review: Ingest facts with sources, prices with history, unknown stock as listed, capacity as assumed, MOQ and steps. Export the exact catalogue projection. Estimate from stock, calendar and capacity; acceptance reserves and books atomically. Verify every original dependency in run_stage_plan before judging its gate.
steps.done_when: The store gate and every dependency in the original stage plan have current evidence, or readiness is recorded as blocked with the missing evidence.

done_when: Catalogue coverage and operational readiness are recorded from current evidence, with unresolved gates left blocked.
